newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Jan tax revenues up 12.7 pct on year ago.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Jan tax revenues up 12.7 pct on year ago.

text.p: Argentina's tax revenues totaled $4.36 billion in January, 12.7 percent more than in January 1996, the Economy Ministry said Monday.
January's tax collection was 13.9 percent higher than in December, when revenues totaled $3.83 billion.
Including contributions for private pension funds, total fiscal revenue was $4.74 billion, 13.9 percent higher than last January and 16.1 percent more than in December.
Total value-added tax collection was 1.80 billion, 10.9 percent higher than in January last year and 19.3 percent more than in December.
Income tax collection was $631.7 million, 12.7 percent higher than in January 1996 and 13.8 percent above December.
January tax revenue compared with an average forecast by analysts in a Reuters poll of $4.01 billion.
